cards.claim: Progressive resolution training (64×64 to 96×96) enables faster convergence
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10 dataset, UltraLight+ CNN architecture (75,530 parameters), multi-phase progressive training, 1.05MB final model size
cards.effect: Faster convergence (magnitude unquantified); maintains efficient deployment
cards.evidence: Experimental demonstration via progressive training protocol; not an isolated ablation or comparative study of resolution schedules
cards.quote: The progressive training protocol, which transitions from 64×64 to 96×96 resolution, enables faster convergence and maintains efficient deployment with a 1.05MB model size.

cards.claim: Dynamic resolution scaling combined with multi-phase training reduces parameters while improving accuracy vs. baseline
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10, UltraLight+ architecture with dynamic resolution scaling and multi-phase training; comparison baseline: MobileNetV2 (0.35α)
cards.effect: 79.6% accuracy on CIFAR-10, 82% parameter reduction vs. MobileNetV2 (75,530 vs. ~427k params), 79% higher accuracy (44.4% → 79.6%)
cards.evidence: Experimental comparison; effect is confounded with architecture changes and other optimizations (hybrid depthwise-separable convolutions, adaptive feature fusion)
cards.quote: Our approach combines dynamic resolution scaling with multi-phase training and introduces hybrid depthwise-separable convolution blocks with adaptive feature fusion mechanisms. UltraLight+ achieves 79.6% accuracy on CIFAR-10 with only 75,530 parameters, representing an 82% parameter reduction compared to MobileNetV2 (0.35α) while delivering 79% higher accuracy (44.4% vs 79.6%).
